She lives on the northern, foggy stretch of {{rt|210|Sinnoh}} in the in the [[Sinnoh]]-based games, while she lives in [[Blackthorn City]] in the [[Johto]]-based games. ==In the games== In Pokémon Diamond, Pearl, Platinum, Brilliant Diamond, and Shining Pearl she mentions that she used to live in a famous city of {{tc|Dragon Tamer}}s until she moved to [[Sinnoh]], and due to this, she is able to teach the move {{m|Draco Meteor}} to the {{player}}'s {{type|Dragon}} Pokémon if its [[friendship]] is maxed out. ==Gallery== ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size:80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{dragon color dark}}; background: #{{dragon color}};" |- |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{dragon color dark}}; background: #{{dragon color light}}; width:80px; height:80px"| [[File:Wilma DPPt OD.png]] |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{dragon color dark}}; background: #{{dragon color light}}; width:80px; height:80px"| [[File:Wilma HGSS OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from

{{color2|000000|Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold and SoulSilver}} |} ==In animation== Wilma's only appearance in animation was in the {{aniseries|DP}} episode ''[[DP156|A Meteoric Rise to Excellence!]]''. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} met up with her after witnessing her teach an {{p|Altaria}} to use {{m|Draco Meteor}}. She explained that many {{pkmn|Trainer}}s, including Altaria's, leave their Pokémon with her so that she can teach them Draco Meteor. Later, a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{AP|Gible}} that Wilma knew showed up and she explained that it shows up frequently. Ash and his friends helped her rescue Altaria from {{TRT}} and she later showed them the way to [[Daybreak Town]]. ===Training=== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Wilma |pkmn=Altaria |type1=Dragon |type2=Flying |img=Wilma Altaria.png |epnum=DP156 |epname=A Meteoric Rise to Excellence! |vajp=Satsuki Yukino |vaen= |desc=Wilma was training a {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s {{p|Altaria}} in ''[[DP156|A Meteoric Rise to Excellence!]]''. Because of its great power, it was kidnapped by {{TRT}}. However, Altaria managed to damage their machine to the point where it was unable to move. It was later rescued by {{AP|Gible}}. Altaria knows {{m|Draco Meteor}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, and {{m|Flamethrower}}.}} ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |main=yes |trainer=Ash |pkmn=Gible |gender=male |type1=Dragon |type2=Ground |img=Wilma Gible.png |epnum=DP156 |epname=A Meteoric Rise to Excellence! |vajp=Daisuke Sakaguchi |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc=Wilma befriended a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Gible}} that was trying to learn {{m|Draco Meteor}} for a long time.
